nodes.body: When HOME (USERPROFILE on Windows) is unset or empty, `MaintenanceBackupStore.ResolveRoot` throws before `Read` can convert the failure into a diagnostic. Physical discovery supports this environment through its user-profile fallback, but this call now aborts the entire inventory, even with an explicit scan root. Include store construction in the preference failure boundary so inventory remains usable with `PreferenceDiagnostics`, while cancellation still propagates.

A corrupt or unreadable lockfile can leave `AllOwnershipClaims` empty while inventory supplies `OwnershipDiagnostics`. For a skill with known source metadata, this still produces the same binding as verified ownerless inventory: an existing suppression remains active and new sets succeed despite unknown ownership. Reject binding capture when ownership diagnostics are present. `Match` will then report inactive external suppression, and `--clear` can still work because it bypasses binding capture.
